'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Noah Dockendorf DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Noah Dockendorf]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' E Ops
* '''Username:''' An-Idea
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
